statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-61145: a double free in the tiffcrop tool when it fails to read a tile or strip (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/issues/736). Upstream fixed it in https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/0ac97aa7a5bffddd88f7cdbe517264e9db3f5bd5 (LibTIFF 4.7.1), which frees the tile buffer on each error path and frees read_buff only when it is not also crop_buff. Debian's trixie security update tiff 4.7.0-3+deb13u1 already applies that commit unchanged, as part of its fix for CVE-2025-8961, although the Debian tracker still lists trixie as vulnerable to CVE-2025-61145 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-61145). Applying the commit in reverse to the 4.7.0 source with Debian's 4.7.0-3+deb13u3 patches succeeds, so every later Debian revision keeps it. The DHI tiff packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie tiff 4.7.0-3+deb13u2 and 4.7.0-3+deb13u3. Every published build is built from one of those two revisions and carries the fix, so the fixed version is the first published DHI tiff build.
